subtitle.secretSanta: Everyone draws a name in secret
subtitle.whiteElephant: Bring a gift, steal a gift

explain.secretSanta: Everyone draws one name in secret and gets that person a gift. Nobody draws their own name, and nobody finds out who their Santa is until gift day.
explain.whiteElephant: Everyone brings one wrapped gift to a shared pile. On gift day you take turns: unwrap a new gift, or steal one that's already open. Whoever loses a gift goes next. In the end, everyone goes home with one gift.
explain.conspiracy: Everyone gets one gift, planned by all the others together. Each person has a board where the others share ideas and pick their gift. Nobody ever sees their own board, so every gift is a surprise.

exchange.label: How are you celebrating?
exchange.inPerson-help: Everyone hands over their gift on gift day.
exchange.online-help: Gifts go by post: everyone adds an address. Unwrap together on a video call.

organizer.name: Your name
organizer.name-help: Everyone in the group sees this name. Already have an account? We'll use its name.
organizer.email-help: We'll send you a code to check it's you. Nothing gets sent to anyone else.
